note.zh-TW: 0-2 以 RD 代表；網站補充的延伸科目，給 RD intensity 等指標使用。
note.en: Represented by RD in the 0-2 slides; an extension account added by the site for ratios such as R&D intensity.

definition.zh-TW: 為了研究與開發新產品、新技術所花的費用。研究階段的支出依 IFRS 一律列為費用。
definition.en: Spending on researching and developing new products or technology. Under IFRS research-phase costs are always expensed.
